svg.title: JobsMatchNow crew: one boat, one course
svg.desc: Comic illustration of the JobsMatchNow team as the crew of one sailing boat heading right toward an island harbour labelled M36, LinkedIn exit (imagined). Founder is captain at the wheel, Avi the harbour pilot stands beside with a compass, Mark hoists the pink-to-orange brand flag, Rev keeps lookout in the crow's nest with a spyglass, Rizer holds a map next to a treasure chest, Selly throws a line from the bow to a small boat labelled US startups, Bui works in the engine room with a wrench, and Desi paints the hull. A buoy near the boat reads M1, you are here, and a distant boat on the horizon is labelled 2nd bidder.
svg.text: JobsMatchNow crew — one boat, one course
